title: Predecessor and Successor | Practice
inputFormat:
Implement findPreSuc(root, key). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
Return [predecessorNode, successorNode]; the editor displays their values or null.
